app-title: Cibiyar Ilimi ta Pioneers ta Afirka - Na Waje
welcome-sub: Ƙofa don Ƙarfafa Afirka ta hanyar Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Don murnar Ranar Afirka ta 25, an ƙaddamar da wannan manhajar horar da Pi Pioneers)
intro-p1: Pi Network kuɗi ne tsarin yanar gizo na dijital wanda aka tsara don sa cryptocurrency ya zama mai sauƙi kuma mai amfani ga kowa.
intro-p2: Ba kamar sauran cryptocurrencies da ke buƙatar injunan hakar ma'adinai masu tsada ba, Pi Network yana ba wa talakawa damar shiga kai tsaye daga wayoyinsu.
ch1-p1: Mataki 1: Zazzage Pi Network - Yi amfani da hanyar: minepi.com/chigalex1
ch1-p2: Mataki 2: Yi rajista da Facebook ko Waya → Shigar da lamba: CHIGALEX1 → Sami ladan Pi 1
ch1-p3: Hakar Kullum: Koma kowane sa'o'i 24 ka danna maɓallin walƙiya don ci gaba da hakar ma'adinai.
security-msg: ⚠️ Tsaron Wallet: Kada ka taɓa raba kalmomin ɓoye sirrinka 24! Ƙungiyar Pi Core ba za ta taɓa tambayarka ba!
ch2: BABI NA 2 — ILIMIN WALLET NA PI
ch2-p1: Wallet ɗin Pi naka banki ne a cikin Pi Ecosystem. Yana riƙe da kuɗin Pi ɗinka amintacce a kan blockchain.
ch5-p1: Ƙimar Yarjejeniya ta Duniya (GCV) tana ƙarfafa amfani na gaske. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Wannan ƙima tana ginawa ne pioneers da ke amfani da Pi a ciniki na gaske.
final-msg: Afirka tana da damar zama ɗaya daga cikin yankuna mafi ƙarfi a amfani mai amfani a cikin Pi Ecosystem. Tare Mun Gina. Tare Mun Koyar.
